title: Deliver explicit-input verified dump command
description: Implement app/cli foxread dump with explicit input/profile identity and output root, composing decoder/projector/full-value sink. Report source coverage, actual entity data path, backend write result and final assessment; use meaningful exit status. Keep CLI/environment precedence explicit if configuration layering is introduced.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end synthetic JSONLZ4 input creates an inspectable win_/tab_ tree; repeat, update, deletion and interrupted-output replay converge correctly. Invalid input leaves existing output unrequested for replacement; unsuccessful verification yields actionable failure. Document runnable source/development commands and required checks.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Apply complete profile values and verify the final owned tree
description: Implement output/caminus schema/application/verification through one native profile entity, full desired-value writes and kubeless-observation-assessment collection Mode::Exact. Obtain expectations through the inventory agreement; perform a complete fail-closed actual walk preserving native path identity or explicitly rejecting unsupported entries. Represent files and directories including empty containers; expose incomplete application and useful mismatches.
acceptance_criteria: Real backend fixtures cover repeated identical writes, value changes, stale windows/tabs, wrong-kind and wrong-content paths, optional values, partial application and full-value replay. Failed walks cannot claim satisfaction; planned WriteReport removals are not accepted as proof of absence. No automatic checkpoint is triggered.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Establish desired encoded inventory and output representation contract
description: Resolve the consumer integration boundary with Kopacetic/Caminus: how the exact desired encoded tree is obtained without a second independent serializer. Use synthetic reflected values to establish path kinds, empty containers, optional text including null/empty/newlines, owned non-dot scope and stale-directory visibility. The kopacetic consumer handoff is needs-only; do not treat prior API proposals as adopted upstream design.
acceptance_criteria: Record the selected source of desired encoded entries with executable evidence against the actual serializer. Establish null/empty text and container semantics and filesystem ownership. Document any upstream prerequisite and provide an implementable interface for foxread output verification; no synthetic inventory is claimed to prove caminus integration.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Project sessionstore into typed windows and tabs
description: Implement firefox/project joining source types to core/model: 1-based active-entry indexing, ordered windows/tabs with win_/tab_ IDs, supported timestamps and metadata, separate closed/deferred state. Publish selected fields rather than arbitrary restoration contents. Scope IDs explicitly; no persistent-matching ledger in this slice.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures prove back navigation selects entries[index-1], duplicate URLs remain distinct, empty/missing histories have explicit meaning, closed records are not current tabs, and last selection/observation time never becomes tab-open time. Reorder does not falsely claim known close/open events.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Establish Rust workspace and normalized observation contract
description: Create the initial Rust workspace with working core/model code, using core/, firefox/, observe/, output/, app/ leaf crate paths without redundant project directory prefixes. Define profiles/windows/tabs, ordering, source generation/availability and honest timestamp semantics. Use typed win_<id>/tab_<id> IDs scoped to an observation, tab allocation unique within its profile observation. Preserve existing repository artifacts pending deliberate replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Model and workspace compile and satisfy formatting/clippy checks; supported timestamps, absence and observation identity are explicit; duplicate/ambiguous browser content does not imply stable lifecycle identity. No unused crate scaffolding or independent diff algorithm.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Decode bounded Firefox JSON and MozLZ4 snapshots
description: Implement firefox/sessionstore as bytes-to-source-shaped-data, independent of filesystem acquisition. Support plain JSON fixtures and unencrypted MozLZ4; validate magic and declared length with input/output limits. Recognize encrypted input distinctly, preserve needed compatibility metadata and reject malformed input honestly.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic fixtures cover valid compressed/plain input, malformed/truncated/oversized data, encrypted magic and unknown optional fields. No source error is interpreted as an empty browser. Document tested Firefox schema/version scope.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Maintain Firefox JSON session snapshots as verified filesystem state
description: Build the multi-crate Rust JSON path: bounded Firefox sessionstore acquisition and projection, complete desired-value persistence through Kopacetic/Caminus, exact final-tree verification, then Watchman-driven convergence. Use domain-grouped crate paths and win_<id>/tab_<id>. Reuse kubeless collection assessment, keyed reporting and scheduling. SQLite extraction belongs to walcap; scalar Assessor and automatic VCS checkpoints are deferred.
acceptance_criteria: A one-shot dump and continuous watcher converge valid observations into the declared owned tree; stale entries and partial failures are visible; restarts and in-flight invalidations preserve pending work. All implementation children are resolved, with optional reporting delivered or explicitly deferred.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Maintain verified output across invalidations failures and restart
description: Implement observe/runner and CLI watch around the same acquisition/project/apply/verify path. Apply selected kubeless timing/queue mechanism; retain dirty/in-flight and pending candidate state, serialized writes and last verified progress. Subscribe before baseline, rescan after reconnect/fresh instance and preserve retry on failure. Offload blocking work without claiming cancellation stops it.
acceptance_criteria: Integration checks prove notices during reads/writes schedule subsequent work, failed writes/verification retry despite unchanged source, fresh-instance/reconnect reacquire source, restart full-value application repairs stale output and source failure does not clear current data. Completion is reported only after actual final-tree assessment.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Assess executor-backed keyed scheduling against measured write behavior
description: Compare kubeless-work-schedule keyed Tokio admission/Scheduler with kubeless-work-schedule-policy using measured dump/verification workloads. Lean toward executor-backed reuse when its semantics fit: Watchman already uses Tokio. Use profile keys, latest invalidation/reacquisition requests, checked admission and bounded batching. Distinguish scheduler admission from write execution/serialization; do not adopt scalar Assessor.
acceptance_criteria: Executable comparison exercises bursts, continuous arrivals, slow in-flight writes, retries of unchanged source, earned wait bounds, close/refusal and independent profile keys. Demonstrate no lost notice during writes and no overlapping same-root writers. Record selected mechanism and merge/config semantics; adopt in runner if suitable without another approval gate, otherwise document concrete reason for policy-only choice.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Measure dump stages and slow-output workload behavior
description: Measure functioning dump stages: decode/project, encoding/planning/writing, tree walk, assessment and total cycle. Exercise first write, identical rewrite, sparse changes and removed windows at declared fixture sizes, plus deliberately slow filesystem/application conditions. Produce arrival schedules for single-profile bursts and sustained invalidations to inform scheduler assessment.
acceptance_criteria: Record reproducible commands, fixture sizes, filesystem/machine context and timing distributions. Separate write and verification costs from batching and total latency. Evidence covers genuinely slower-than-arrival work; no fixed performance promise or arbitrary selection threshold.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Integrate Watchman invalidation and recovery signals
description: Implement observe/watch using official watchman_client. Handle resolved root/relative paths, directory replacement, invalidation, fresh-instance/rescan and cancellation/disconnect. Drain notifications independently from expensive application work. Setup failure is explicit; do not silently substitute another backend.
acceptance_criteria: Verify correct profile-relative filtering with wider roots, replacement/deletion notices, fresh-instance behavior and reconnect lifecycle. Controlled tests do not need personal Firefox data. No notification is presented as a browser transaction or durable content log.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Acquire profile session files with explicit lifecycle roles
description: Implement firefox/profile acquisition for explicit profile directories and source paths. Distinguish runtime recovery, clean shutdown, previous backup and unavailable/encrypted input; declare watched paths. Preserve source role and degraded fallback evidence rather than sorting all files by mtime or inferring browser liveness from existence.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic profile layouts cover startup/shutdown transitions, replacement/read races, old backups alongside clean state and unavailable inputs. No missing file becomes an empty browser or a reliable tab-closure signal. Pure codec remains independent of profile discovery.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md

title: Report keyed changes between normalized observations
description: Add optional observation-change reporting as a small consumer module over kubeless-view-change alignment and ChangeSet. Reuse selected keys and equality; keep source generation and coverage explicit. This is reporting, not a mutation program for caminus, and blocks neither dump nor watch.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover additions/removals/value changes, duplicate key refusal and positional reorder ambiguity. Outputs never equate uncertain structural changes with proven tab open/close. Reuses kubeless public API without a new standalone diff crate or custom alignment algorithm.
notes: Commissioned and scoped in opencode://ses_ec59f6862ffeFt6UN2FUOhTXOO. Current design: design/implementation/plan0.gpt6a.md
